name: Generation Gap
description: Four-piece Long Island rock cover band made up of two millennials and two Gen-Xers who play high-energy crowd-pleasing rock hits. It plays South Shore Nassau spots such as Kitty O'Hara's in Baldwin and Montana Bros in Freeport, plus free summer concerts on Freeport's Nautical Mile.

dancing.notes: A bar rock band that promises high-energy crowd pleasers; people may freestyle dance at its pub and pizzeria shows, but we found no report or photo caption describing dancing.

evidence.note: Band site: four-piece, high-energy rock 'n' roll cover band from Long Island playing crowd pleasers.
Show list: Kitty O'Hara's (Baldwin), Montana Bros (Freeport), BrightEye Beer Co. (Long Beach), 8-11 pm sets.
Long Island Arts Council at Freeport listing for a free Aug 13, 2026 Nautical Mile concert by the band.

reviewNotes: Added from the town-by-town source search (2026-10-05) for source generation-gap. A YouTube channel '@GenerationGap-Band' posts 2026 videos from a Pennsylvania car show; we did not confirm it is this band, so it is not linked.
